title: Yuanjing Integrated Urban Management Platform
summary: China Unicom describes AI dispatch, monitoring, and event management. The chapter provides no observed city-service improvement.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Unicom describes AI dispatch, monitoring, and event management. The chapter provides no observed city-service improvement. Urban-management product development.
purpose: Help municipalities detect issues, dispatch resources, and respond to residents.

ratings.reason: Municipal operators are intended to allocate resources and handle requests more efficiently.
Residents are intended to receive more responsive basic services.
More inclusive and resource-efficient cities are intended outcomes, with no measured change supplied.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: Yuanjing Integrated Urban Management Platform

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Specific replication requirements are not established in the extracted chapter.
